proving_notes: Entries below locate source obligations; linking is not a passed test. Keep current native test IDs and their source-cut evidence at execution.
Original #211 W10 has 15 clauses; current TUI section 22 has 14. Both sets and all eight Journeys remain represented; do not silently replace one denominator with the other.
Each new source revision requires a delta review for additional or changed obligations. A static count is not evidence of future completeness.
CI source/fixture, cross-product, actual provider, physical material, real UI and human EX observations remain separate. Each episode records exactly what it exercised.
Family links are candidates; discover exact native capability IDs, operation schemas, credentials, actual context/loading and grants before an episode. Library dependencies may be transitive.
Herdr, tmux and cmux each require a separate actual-provider variant where supported. A generic mux pass or an absent incompatible platform is not evidence for all three.

Full Telegram proof requires actual client messages and real recipient work, not a journal, echo or Bot API connectivity probe. Other advertised connector capabilities receive explicit support and proof dispositions.
